question: Two trains are moving in the opposite direction and their speeds are in the ratio of 2 : 1. If the first train crosses a standing man in 5 sec and another train crosses the same man in 8 sec, then determine the time taken by trains to cross each other.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the speeds of the two trains be 2 units and 1 unit respectively.

Length of first train = Speed × Time = 2 × 5 = 10 units.

Length of second train = Speed × Time = 1 × 8 = 8 units.

Relative speed in opposite directions = 2 + 1 = 3 units.

Time to cross each other = Total Length ÷ Relative Speed = (10 + 8) ÷ 3 = 18 ÷ 3 = 6 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of speeds of two trains = 2 : 1

Time taken by 1st train to cross a standing man = 5 sec

Time taken by 2nd train to cross the same man = 8 sec

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (opposite directions) = Sum of speeds = S₁ + S₂

Time to cross = Total Length ÷ Relative Speed
